summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MicroXisto EasyX PWA bulk import feature and Service Worker caching fix. All 11 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed. Features verified: 'Importar do Excel' button in Admin > Estudo Mercado tab, import panel with instructions, tab-separated data parsing, preview table with R$/ha calculation, successful bulk import to database, dashboard updates after import.
critical_code_review_comments: Bulk import API correctly validates required fields (empresa, produto) and returns detailed error messages
R$/ha calculation is done server-side: rs_ha = dose_ha * valor
Default values applied for missing fields: venda='Venda direta', estado='SP', cultura='Soja'
Service Worker v14 uses network-first strategy with proper no-cache headers
index.html registers SW with ?v=14 and updateViaCache: 'none' for cache busting
seed_data_creation: Test records created during testing (TEST_* prefix) were cleaned up. Database has 17 market studies.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk import feature fully tested and working. Key test scenarios covered: 1) Successful import with all fields 2) Empty empresa/produto validation 3) Decimal values handling 4) Default values for missing fields 5) Admin authentication required 6) Response structure validation 7) Dashboard updates after import 8) Filter options include new data. Service Worker caching: sw.js v14 with network-first strategy, no-cache headers verified.
